notes: SECONDARY source, used for the per-lane encoding table (CXL 1.x-2.0 at 32 GT/s: 3.938 GB/s per lane, 63.015 GB/s at x16; CXL 3.x at 64 GT/s: 7.563 GB/s per lane, 121.0 GB/s at x16; CXL 4.0 at 128 GT/s: 15.126 GB/s per lane, 242.0 GB/s at x16), all labelled full duplex.
